patch: 0781-perf-cudagraph-target-full-replay-and-post-gate-fork.patch (r1, SHA-256 29623124ed864bb1...; author Christopher Owen <3221756+christopherowen@users.noreply.github.com>, Sun 8 Nov 2026 11:30 +0100, kept; Round 1 section with the measured cells)
root_cause: 0781's FULL fast-path condition in GPUModelRunner.execute_model (model_runner.py:3204 in candidate-53's tree) calls self.kv_connector.has_connector(). No KVConnector in this base defines it: not the no-op base class that NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR instantiates, not ActiveKVConnector, and not upstream vLLM main's KVConnector (80362712, 2026-11-09). The only has_connector in the tree is KVTransferConfig.has_connector(connector_name), a config method. The first runtime FULL step, the warm-up decode step, raised AttributeError on every rank. #960's own mark and the release tests never ran a non-dummy FULL step through execute_model.
fix: model_runner.py: 'and not self.kv_connector.has_connector()' -> 'and self.kv_connector is NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR' (plus a one-line comment). get_kv_connector returns NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR when no KV transfer group exists and an ActiveKVConnector otherwise. NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR is already imported by the runner. Semantics as #960 intended: the fast path runs only with no active KV connector, because an active connector's pre_forward reads the step's attention metadata. An identity check fails closed: any other connector object takes the eager path.
other_upstream_only_apis: None found. Every receiver.attribute in 0781's non-test added lines was checked against the base (raw/setup/audit-attrs-name-grep.txt plus a type-aware manual check): BlockTables.cp_size, AttentionGroup.get_metadata_builder, DeepseekV41B12xMetadataBuilder.prepare_cudagraph_replay(qsl, seq_lens, block_table, slot_mapping, nr, nt), DefaultModelState.prepare_attn and vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.default, InputBuffers.query_start_loc/seq_lens, BlockTables.input_block_tables/slot_mappings, ced_kernels.requests(..., compact=), CEDState.counts/starts/request_positions/replay_start, DeepseekV41ModelState._ced_rows (3-tuple) and _ced_batch exist; the rest the patch adds. Semantics checked too: the non-compact requests kernel ignores limits, so stage_floors not restaging limits is safe; FULL steps never carry a CED plan (prepare_attn raises otherwise); DFlash/DSpark propose never reads the target attn_metadata.
